title: Armstrong Number
description: Determine if an n-digit number is an Armstrong number by checking if the sum of its digits raised to the power of n equals the number itself.
pseudocode:
1. Get digits of n and store in array
2. Calculate n = number of digits
3. Calculate sum of digits raised to power of n
4. Compare sum to original number

steps.note: Extract digits of 153 into an array.
Compare result 153 with original number 153; return true.
